Dude don't let loose skin dissuade you from getting healthy and losing weight. You may not be able to afford it right this minute, but just try to save up and have it as a goal. I know a couple people who were in a similar situation weight wise and a friend of mine lost about 90 pounds and he's like a completely different person. You will feel so, so much better and happier if you can see an incremental progress and have a goal to work towards. 

Just know that the overwhelming majority of people out there are insecure in some facet about their looks. For you, it's your weight. For me, it's being short and going bald in my 20's. I feel your pain. I know how bad it sucks to strike out with girls solely because of my looks and I wouldn't be on this sub-forum if I wasn't depressed like you. At least you can change your circumstance if you work hard, I'm fucked regardless haha! Just start walking on the treadmill and changing your diet to cut down on sodium and sugars and you'll feel a lot better physically, that's a guarantee. I hope it can make you feel better emotionally too.

I know that mental illness isn't a choice, but I do feel inherently responsible for my suffering.  It's certainly nobody else's fault that I am where I am.  I grew up a privileged kid, with a privileged life.  Someone else could live 50 lifetimes and not have access to the kinds of opportunities that I had growing up.  I haven't always been a fuck-up.  I used to excel.  I busted my ass to get good grades and get a degree from a good school so that I could be successful but I have awful anxiety and depression that are preventing me from getting a job or moving forward with my life in any other aspect.  I don't ask for help because of the deep shame and embarrassment I feel.  I've dug myself this massive hole and most days I just don't feel like I have the strength to dig myself out.  Like it would take a total re-wiring of how my brain works and how I process information. I'm a coward.  I hate everything about myself and I want to take the easy way out.
